headlines.title: Arsenal go six points clear after lively draw at Newcastle
headlines.description: Noni Madueke's second-half goal earns Arsenal a 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park, as the reigning champions move six points clear at the top of the Premier League table.

headlines.title: Why Arsenal are behind in race for Champions League spots
headlines.description: Arsenal were open about their aim to win the WSL this season but they find themselves well adrift - where have things gone wrong?

headlines.title: Raya set to have scan on injury - how much would Arsenal miss him?
headlines.description: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.
